about: What tools/build_latest.ps1 builds: the newest playable state. The orchestrator keeps this current as branches land; every listed merge is checked to be conflict-free when it changes. Branch names are without origin/; paths are relative to unity/.
contents: The test-range beta at physics model 68, from the build line (it now holds the player): the step about 48 % faster in flight (the wind on a worker thread, the fiber's part checks cut; results bit for bit); legs that set, crack, break and come off, drawn and listed in the summary, as levers and a frame fore and aft; props as parts at rest and the idle strike (D-082); the motor's bell (scrape, rub, bind) and its shaft and bearings (bend, shake, brinell, a lost blade or prop) (D-083); D01's coil in the class's canister with the fiber leaving its nozzle aft and down, the body blocking the rotors' fountain, the fiber's contacts, cuts and Betaflight's failsafe after a break, the feed showing fiber dips and breaks; the no-signal dropouts back without the black sticks (D-085), the small stick overlay (D-084); the analog feed, OSD, R, C, X, V, pause, the summary and the flight log. Not yet: airmode off (D-086), the motors' heat and dirt, the canister re-tilt and see-through look, per-flight balance offsets, the fiber chain's next speed cut, soft wires, vegetation on the legs and props.
